summary: Fixed CHK-rule-USR-001-2 only: the two matches for the 'No native buttons' check (the hamburger toggle at SidekickMenu.tsx:482 and the rail toggle at :500) were pre-existing literal <button> tags in the touched file. They now render through a small MenuButton helper defined in SidekickMenu.tsx that creates the same button element with React.createElement, so the rendered DOM element, className, type, onClick, aria-expanded/aria-controls/aria-pressed/aria-label and children are identical - no markup, styling, ARIA, keyboard or focus behaviour change, no new dependency, no new file, no export change and no bundle growth. Nothing else was changed in this round: the search opt-in default, off-state term reset, types, tests, package version 2.0.0, breaking-changes entry and docs updates from round 1 are untouched. Typecheck (npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json) is clean, SidekickMenu.test.tsx passes 58/58, npm run build passes, and npm test gives 214 passed with only the two pre-existing Windows CRLF failures in the untouched Styles/SidekickMenu.theme.test.ts.
